step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture shows two user tiers (Enterprise and Standard Users) accessing a shared API Gateway and Business Logic layer. The Business Logic layer queries an I3 service (Fargate + DynamoDB) to route requests either to a shared multi-tenant Aurora database (encrypted with a Platform KMS key) or a customer-dedicated Aurora database (encrypted via a Customer-owned KMS key).
